slice: Three regional requirement hard negatives through the governed local Qwen3 pair
platform: macOS 27 arm64; repository-pinned Rust 1.97.1; unconstrained 64 GiB host

fixture.kind: synthetic JobRequirementToResumeEvidence pairs in the existing EvalFixtureSet schema
fixture.oracle: Three expected positive/negative boundaries were fixed and independently reviewed before model execution. Region framing does not assert citizenship, language fluency, legal requirements, qualification equivalence, or real candidate eligibility.
fixture.scope: Characterization of existing production matching; no model thresholds, prompts, inference code, or frozen ten-pair seed changed.

test_source.annotation_only_change: Added an explicit ignore reason after inference. Model inputs, test body, and assertions did not change; the final default-lane check passed with the model test still ignored.

models.cache_policy: Retained as an ignored, repository-owned public-model test cache for subsequent goal work. It is not the user's app profile or a shipped model payload. Setup uses pinned files, exact sizes/checksums, anonymous downloads, and app-scoped transfer staging. No user data was uploaded.

findings: All three paired production calls selected the direct positive; each negative-only production call remained unmatched with Qwen3Reranked provenance.
The India negative ranked above the positive in dense similarity. Reranking corrected the order and rejected the wrong-unit evidence; dense similarity alone does not establish equivalence.
The UK negative is only about 0.751 below the acceptance floor, narrower than the one-point margins in earlier frozen calibration sets. This seed result does not establish broad regional calibration.
All observations were collected before behavioral assertions. Existing evidence vectors were reused for paired and negative-only production calls.
